notes: Reference kind: all patients had IOP above 21 mmHg on maximum medical therapy before the procedure and all medications were continued postoperatively (Methods).
Method: the article does not name a tonometer.

Roles: both groups received the same standard procedure with two commercially available versions of the same probe used in consecutive periods; neither is declared an experimental arm, so both are control groups.

Inclusion required at least 1 year of follow-up (selection by follow-up length; the Discussion reports that only about half of treated patients met it). A few eyes had additional glaucoma surgery within the year; the article does not state that they were removed from the visit means, so no outcome-defined exclusion applies.
The Abstract/Results text and Table 2 disagree in the last decimal place for the original-probe 1-year mean; the Table 2 cell is cited.
One patient in the revised-probe group contributed both eyes (22 eyes, 21 patients).
Mean number of antiglaucoma medications per visit is stacked in the same Table 2 cells (not extracted).
